verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents a REST API that authenticates with OAuth 2.0 Client Credentials, which the docs describe as "suited for server-to-server calls without an end user." That flow supports unattended, headless automation of cards, statements, reconciliation, categories and users through scoped credentials. Missing for 10: no CLI or CI-pipeline guidance or examples, no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returned 404), no official SDKs, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.
